messages:
Ava PM: quick one — AcmeHealth wants a 99.99% SLA for Dedicated plus guaranteed burst slots during their peak windows. They also asked for a billing credit if we miss it. Can we accept for GA this quarter?
Diego Eng: do we have recent telemetry to show we can sustain p95 < 80ms and <1% errors for their expected QPS?
Sanjay SRE: short answer: not for every region. We hit p95 70ms on our core tests but tail risk on long-context runs is higher. Need a burn-in + chaos window.
Maya Sales: Acme is ready to sign if we can offer a commercial backstop. proposal: 99.95% + 2x burst slots + 1 month credit if we breach twice in a rolling 90d.
Ava PM: that feels like a large exposure. what would 99.95 → 99.99 delta mean in terms of engineered changes? Diego?
Diego Eng: engineering work: reservation slots, preemptible fallback, and KV cache warming for their prefix patterns. Estimate 3 sprints to make deterministic. Also need autoscale SLOs tuned.
Sanjay SRE: ops requirements: runbook, canary for 2 weeks, golden signals added to console, and a capacity test harness that simulates their traffic shape. plus SLA burn-in run.
Ruth Docs: doc gaps: no customer-facing SLA page for Dedicated that calls out credits/measurement windows. also need a runbook stub and a short on-call checklist for this customer.
Maya Sales: would accept a phased commitment if we can document rollout milestones. suggested milestone checklist: 1) performance baseline 2) canary 3) contractual SLA activation.
Ava PM: proposal from product: gate activation of billing credits until post-canary + 30d stable. technical activation only after we validate 4-week burn-in. Commercial activation after legal signoff.
Diego Eng: implementation notes — we should add a toggle on the routing layer: "dedicated-burst-enabled" with these semantics:
```
route: dedicated-burst-enabled: true
burst_slots: 50
fallback_model: core-medium
credit_policy_trigger: two_breaches_90d
```
Diego Eng: that gives us a way to flip off for emergencies.
Sanjay SRE: also want prometheus metrics shipped -> redwood.console: dedicated_acmehealth: golden_latency_p50/p95/p99, error_rate, drop_rate, slot_utilization. Add alert if p99 > 250ms or error_rate > 0.5% for 5m.
Ruth Docs: I'll draft the SLA page + runbook template. ETA 3 days for a first pass. Need product wording for credit formula.
Maya Sales: legal needs a clear SL clause. I'll start a ticket with contract language and link to this thread.
Ava PM: decision checklist for GA acceptance of this customer's SLA ask:
- Perf baseline validated (engineering)
- Canary (2 weeks) with double-ended monitoring (prod + internal)
- Runbook + oncall playbook in docs
- Billing credit formula + legal signoff
- Toggle + fallback implemented
If any of these missing -> offer 99.95 + temporary burst pilot.
Sanjay SRE: agree. will schedule capacity test for next Tue. I'll add runbook items to the incident playbook.
ops-bot: Ticket created: PROD-9834 "AcmeHealth SLA program: capacity test & runbook" — assignees: @Sanjay SRE, @Diego Eng.
Ava PM: thanks — Ruth, Maya, Diego, Sanjay: please update this thread when you have PRs/tickets. I'll sync with legal after runbook draft. :thumbsup:
Maya Sales: noted, will prioritize contract intake.
Ruth Docs: first doc draft uploaded to Google Drive, link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link (will add to repo after review).
Diego Eng: starting the route toggle patch today, will open PR and tag this thread.
Sanjay SRE: pushing capacity harness tests into CI — expect results by Tue.
Ava PM: excellent. next check-in Friday EOD. if anyone sees blockers before then ping me. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
